Subject: Tri-party demo — slot arbiter proposal and DST note

Hi Anne / Tom —

Thanks again for the interest in a short executive-level demo and discussion. We need to lock a 45-minute window that works for leadership in EMEA, US, and APAC. To avoid repeated back-and-forth, attaching an "exec-availability-grid.csv" with our initial availability and a simple proposal: pick one slot from column "A" or "B" or flag if both are impossible.

Key constraints:
- We are aiming for week of Oct 25–29. Note: Europe moves clocks back on Oct 31 this year; that can shift the ET/CET gap after the week, so confirm whether the meeting will recur.
- Preference: keep executive participants between 8:30–18:00 local where possible. We recognize that means someone may be at an off-hour (sunrise/sunset trade-off).

Candidate slots (converted):
A) 16:00 UTC — US (12:00 EDT), UK (17:00 BST), Japan (01:00 JST next day)
B) 07:00 UTC — US (03:00 EDT), UK (08:00 BST), Japan (16:00 JST)
C) 20:00 UTC — US (16:00 EDT), UK (21:00 BST), Japan (05:00 JST next day)

Ask: please reply with preferred slot letter (A/B/C) or propose an exact UTC time. If none work, Mark the row in the attached csv and we will run a tie-breaker.

Agenda (brief): 1) 10-min executive demo highlights, 2) 20-min Q&A on integration & SLAs, 3) 15-min next-steps / procurement path (HubSpot HS-48291).

Attachments: exec-availability-grid.csv, demo-brief-v2.pdf
